english.title: Cause use of a trap / snare etc to kill / take a wild bird
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowingly caused the use of

(A)_[a springe ]_
(B)_[a trap]_
(C)_[a gin]_
(D)_[a snare]_
(E)_[a hook and line]_
(F)_[an electrical device for killing, stunning or frightening]_
(G)_[a poisonous, poisoned or stupefying substance]_
(H)_[a net]_
(I)_[a baited board]_
(J)_[bird lime or a substance of a like nature to bird lime]_
(K)_[**(..SPECIFY WHERE MORE THAN ONE FROM THE ABOVE OPTIONS USED IN SAME INCIDENT..)]_

for the purpose of killing or taking a wild bird
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 5(1)(f) and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 27 for meaning of "wild bird".
(ii) See Section 21(6) for the forfeiture provisions.
(iii) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.
(iv) As amended by paragraph 10 to Schedule 12 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(v) See also offence wording H4579.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Where more than one bird is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each bird (Section 21(5)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
